pages.title: Bind
pages.text:
**Sigil.** Two of Clock, Swarm, Spark seated, a Strand Filament in hand, right-click the Post: **Braid Cord**.\
Then seals and rites — Tribal Power's own, with Nature's Aura, Ars Nouveau, and Occultism as peers. Carve carefully.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text:
**Goal:** spin **Braid Cord** and seat Sigil.\
You need any two of Clock, Swarm and Spark seated, a **Strand Filament**, and a **Tension Post**.\
**Check:** Seat any two of Clock, Swarm and Spark. Right-click the Post with a Strand Filament for **Braid Cord**. Finish Sigil, then seat the Sigil token.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
